caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden spoon positioned diagonally on a plain, light beige background. The spoon features a brown, oval-shaped bowl with visible wood grain patterns in shades of darker and lighter brown. The handle is long and carved, decorated with geometric and linear designs in a slightly lighter brown color. The end of the handle curves back onto itself and is adorned with a solid, faceted square ornament. The handle also contains cut-out portions that form arch-like shapes. The composition is centered, with the spoon as the only object, and there are no other elements in the background. Small, faint text at the bottom center reads “Minnesota Art Project Work Projects Administration,” and “Wilbur M. Rice” is written in the lower right corner.
title: Wooden Spoon
